4 points = 1 rupee

For sales
Give 1 point for every Rs.100. Ex: if a car is worth 10L (ex-showroom) then the customer gets 10000 points. 
Note: points should only be on ex-showroom price, not on on-road price. 

For service:
Give 4 points for every Rs.100. Ex: if service bill is Rs.10000, then give 400 points. 

Referral: case by case - ask Umesh, Shrinivas, and Shivanand 

Everytime a customer spends, they should automatically get a WhatsApp message with the new points earned and total points available. 

Redeeming points:
Customer should be able to redeem any time after 1 year (keep this timespan variable) of purchase. 
While redeeming, they should get an OTP, and the same should be shared with the cashier. Cashier inputs the customer’s OTP and how many points to redeem. 

Automatically discount should be applied and a unique code should be generated. That should be accounted in real-books. (This process can be automated)
